items.assumptions: α无理，任意实截断N≥1和任意实Sobolev阶r；没有把有限频带的下界当成全频带下界。
quantifiers: MathGauge.GP002.radius: MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℝ

MathGauge.GP002.mem_frequencyBand: ∀ (N : ℝ) (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
  k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N ↔ k ≠ 0 ∧ MathGauge.GP002.radius k ≤ N
MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand_nonempty: ∀ {N : ℝ}, 1 ≤ N → (MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N).Nonempty

MathGauge.GP002.supported_series_eq_finite_sum: ∀ {B : Finset MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency} {a : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℂ},
  MathGauge.GP002.Supported B a →
    ∀ (x : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Plane),
      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.series a x =
        ∑ k ∈ B, a k * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.mode k x

MathGauge.GP002.bandConstant_formula: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N),
  MathGauge.GP002.bandConstant α N hN =
    (MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N).sup' ⋯ fun k => 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|)

MathGauge.GP002.nativeBand_iff_fourier_support: ∀ (N : ℝ) (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N u ↔
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u ∧
      MathGauge.GP002.Supported (MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N)
        (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.coefficient (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coverOf u))
MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse: ℝ → ℝ → C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ) → C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_solves: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ (N : ℝ) (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
      MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
        MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N (MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth (MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
              ∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F)) y = F y

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_unique: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ (N : ℝ) (F u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
      MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
        MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N u →
          (∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2), MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑u) y = F y) →
            u = MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F

MathGauge.GP002.nativeTransport_band: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)) (hu : MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N u),
  MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeTransport α u ⋯)

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_left_inverse: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ (N : ℝ) (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)) (hu : MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N u),
      MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeTransport α u ⋯) = u

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_norm: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (r : ℝ) (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ≤
      MathGauge.GP002.bandConstant α N hN * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑F

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_norm_attained: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (r : ℝ),
  ∃ F,
    MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F ∧
      0 < MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑F ∧
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) =
          MathGauge.GP002.bandConstant α N hN * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑F

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_best_constant: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (r C : ℝ),
  (∀ (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
      MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ≤
          C * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑F) →
    MathGauge.GP002.bandConstant α N hN ≤ C
items.domains: 实际T²上的复值有限三角多项式；0<Euclidean |k|≤N。频率先用ℤ×ℤ，母题frequencyEquiv证明与Fin 2→ℤ的对应。
items.conclusions: 实际微分算子保持H_N，构造双侧逆与唯一性；最优范数是有限频带上1/(2π|αk1+k2|)的最大值，任意r相同且单频取到。
items.representation: NativeBand是实际有限Fourier和的像，并与真实系数支持条件等价；supported_series_eq_finite_sum把级数落实为有限和。以对所有输入的上界、非零输入取等和best_constant刻画实际逆范数；不是未证明的证书常量。

items.assumptions: α无理；c>0、s≥0且全部非零整频率满足原下界；F真实光滑零均值；r任意实，q≥0，N≥1。
quantifiers:
MathGauge.GP002.small_divisor_hypothesis_iff: ∀ (α s c : ℝ),
  (∀ (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
      k ≠ 0 → c * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairWeight k ^ (-s) ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|) ↔
    ∀ (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
      k ≠ 0 → c ≤ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairWeight k ^ s * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|

MathGauge.GP002.cutoffWeight_le_pairWeight: ∀ {N : ℝ},
  0 ≤ N →
    ∀ (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
      N ≤ MathGauge.GP002.radius k → MathGauge.GP002.cutoffWeight N ≤ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairWeight k
MathGauge.GP002.cutoffWeight_power: ∀ (N q : ℝ), MathGauge.GP002.cutoffWeight N ^ (-q) = (1 + N ^ 2) ^ (-q / 2)

MathGauge.GP002.truncate_inverse_commute: ∀ (α N : ℝ) (a : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℂ),
  MathGauge.GP002.truncate N (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α a) =
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α (MathGauge.GP002.truncate N a)

MathGauge.GP002.inverse_tail_bound: ∀ {α s c : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    0 ≤ s →
      0 < c →
        (∀ (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
            k ≠ 0 → c ≤ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairWeight k ^ s * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|) →
          ∀ (a : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℂ),
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Rapid a →
              a 0 = 0 →
                ∀ (N r q : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ N →
                    0 ≤ q →
                      MathGauge.GP002.sequenceNorm r
                          (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α a -
                            MathGauge.GP002.truncate N (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α a)) ≤
                        1 / (2 * Real.pi * c) * (1 + N ^ 2) ^ (-q / 2) * MathGauge.GP002.sequenceNorm (r + s + q) a

MathGauge.GP002.truncation_estimate: ∀ {α s c : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    0 ≤ s →
      0 < c →
        (∀ (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
            k ≠ 0 → c ≤ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairWeight k ^ s * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|) →
          ∀ (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth F →
              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑F →
                ∀ (N r q : ℝ),
                  1 ≤ N →
                    0 ≤ q →
                      ∃ u,
                        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u ∧
                          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑u ∧
                            (∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑u) y = F y) ∧
                              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r
                                  (⇑u - ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F)) ≤
                                1 / (2 * Real.pi * c) * (1 + N ^ 2) ^ (-q / 2) *
                                  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm (r + s + q) ⇑F

MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries_reconstruct: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)) (hu : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u),
  MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries
      (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.coefficient (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coverOf u)) ⋯ =
    u

MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries_sub: ∀ {a b : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℂ} (ha : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Rapid a)
  (hb : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Rapid b),
  MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries (a - b) ⋯ = MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries a ha - MathGauge.GP002.nativeSeries b hb

MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse_solves: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ (N : ℝ) (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
      MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
        MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N (MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth (MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) ∧
              ∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F)) y = F y

MathGauge.GP002.uniform_truncation_estimate: for fixed irrational α, real s≥0,c>0 and the actual small-divisor bound, every actual smooth zero-mean torus F admits one u, Smooth u and MeanZero u and transport α u = F, such that for all real N,r,q with 1≤N and 0≤q the exact tail inequality holds. The existential u precedes every N,r,q quantifier.
items.domains: 实际归一化T²，实际原生方向导数、真实积分Fourier系数及题定Euclidean Sobolev范数。
items.conclusions: 构造同一个实际光滑零均值解u，有限频带解就是对F_N逐模求逆；证明精确(2πc)^−1(1+N²)^(-q/2)尾估计，包含q=0。
items.representation: 先证明原文c⟨k⟩^(-s)下界与乘权形式等价，再由Rapid的真正导数级数收敛构造nativeSeries；Parseval/Fourier表示桥保持实际范数，尾部差不是虚构形式级数。 uniform_truncation_estimate 先以 N=1,r=q=0 固定一个解，再由已证真实零均值解唯一性将所有 N,r,q 的精确估计转到该同一个解；没有依赖范数指标重新选解。

items.assumptions: 相同有限频带N≥1；两个方向都在该带满足同一个δ>0下界；原文α、β无理可用于S1的逆身份。
quantifiers:
MathGauge.GP002.multiplier_difference: ∀ (α β : ℝ) (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k ≠ 0 →
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k ≠ 0 →
      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier α k - MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier β k =
        ↑((β - α) * ↑k.1) /
          (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.omega * ↑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k) *
            ↑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k))

MathGauge.GP002.multiplier_difference_norm: ∀ (α β : ℝ) (k : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k ≠ 0 →
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k ≠ 0 →
      ‖MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier α k - MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier β k‖ =
        |α - β| * |↑k.1| /
          (2 * Real.pi * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k| * |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k|)

MathGauge.GP002.multiplier_difference_bound: ∀ {α β δ N : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    ∀ k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N,
      δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k| →
        δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k| →
          ‖MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier α k - MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalMultiplier β k‖ ≤
            |α - β| * N / (2 * Real.pi * δ ^ 2)

MathGauge.GP002.finite_direction_difference: ∀ {α β δ N : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    1 ≤ N →
      (∀ k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N, δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|) →
        (∀ k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N, δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k|) →
          ∀ (r : ℝ) (a : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairFrequency → ℂ),
            MathGauge.GP002.Supported (MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N) a →
              MathGauge.GP002.sequenceNorm r
                  (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α a -
                    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients β a) ≤
                |α - β| * N / (2 * Real.pi * δ ^ 2) * MathGauge.GP002.sequenceNorm r a

MathGauge.GP002.native_direction_difference: ∀ {α β δ N : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    1 ≤ N →
      (∀ k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N, δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α k|) →
        (∀ k ∈ MathGauge.GP002.frequencyBand N, δ ≤ |MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor β k|) →
          ∀ (r : ℝ) (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
            MathGauge.GP002.NativeBand N F →
              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r
                  (⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse α N F) - ⇑(MathGauge.GP002.finiteNativeInverse β N F)) ≤
                |α - β| * N / (2 * Real.pi * δ ^ 2) * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑F
items.domains: 同一实际F∈H_N，任意实r；比较两实际环面函数的H^r范数。
items.conclusions: 精确证明||uα−uβ||≤|α−β|N/(2πδ²)||F||；没有扩展为全频率或所有参数统一界。
items.representation: 复逆乘子差先作真实代数恒等式，再取模；保留两个不同小除数因子，最后通过已证明的真实Fourier函数桥求和。

items.assumptions: 任意无理α；全部非负实损失s和所有实阶r；特定α*=√2−1；m任意自然数。
quantifiers: MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth: C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ) → Prop
MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero: (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2 → ℂ) → Prop
MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport: ℝ → (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2 → ℂ) → MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2 → ℂ

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.smooth_iff_coverOf: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u ↔ ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coverOf u)

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm_eq_cover: ∀ (r : ℝ) (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm r ⇑u =
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.hNorm r (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coverOf u)

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm_eq_cover: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u →
    ∀ (m : ℕ),
      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm m ⇑u =
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.cmNormCover m (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coverOf u)

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_solution_unique: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ {u v : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)},
      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u →
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth v →
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑u →
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑v →
              (∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑u) y = MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α (⇑v) y) →
                u = v

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_smoothSurjective_iff: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.NativeSmoothSurjective α ↔
      ∃ s, 0 ≤ s ∧ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.HasDivisorBound α s)
MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_sobolev_iff: ∀ (α s : ℝ), MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.NativeSobolevEstimates α s ↔ MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.HasDivisorBound α s

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_quadratic_sobolev_iff: ∀ {s : ℝ},
  0 ≤ s → (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.NativeSobolevEstimates MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.quadraticDirection s ↔ 1 ≤ s)

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_fixed_full_solution: ∀ (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)) (hF : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth F),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑F →
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF) ∧
      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF) ∧
        (∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.quadraticDirection
                (⇑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF)) y =
              F y) ∧
          (∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u →
                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑u →
                  (∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.quadraticDirection (⇑u) y =
                        F y) →
                    u = MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF) ∧
            ∀ (m : ℕ),
              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm m ⇑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF) ≤
                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.fourConstant m * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm (m + 4) ⇑F

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_fixed_Cm_bound: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)) (hF : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth F),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm m ⇑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeFixedInverse F hF) ≤
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.fourConstant m * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCNorm (m + 4) ⇑F

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_sobolev_summable: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u →
    ∀ (r : ℝ),
      Summable fun k => MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.weight k ^ (2 * r) * ‖MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.coeff (⇑u) k‖ ^ 2

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.native_CMValues_bounded: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u → ∀ (m : ℕ), BddAbove (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeCMValues m ⇑u)
items.domains: 真正UnitAddTorus(Fin 2)、归一化Haar、实际平移曲线导数、光滑阶∞、零积分、Euclidean Fourier权和指定有序混合偏导C^m范数。
items.conclusions: 光滑唯一可解iff存在有限多项式小除数下界；全部Sobolev损失精确端点判据；α*最小损失1且取到；所有m的真实C^(m+4)到C^m估计。
items.representation: 完整母题19模块逐字节复用并重编译，全部表示与分析桥在闭包内。旧母题可选的最优算术常数/最近整数替代刻画不是本阶段新增义务；没有把母题模型成绩或旧证据继承为本组成绩。

items.assumptions: 任意非空开集J（因此涵盖任意含α*的开区间）；任意有限实常数C及s≥0；所有测试方向依然无理。
quantifiers:
MathGauge.GP002.divisor_bound_of_zero_order_estimate: ∀ {α s C : ℝ},
  (∀ (f : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Plane → ℂ),
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.UnitPeriodic f →
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.coefficient f 0 = 0 →
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.hNorm 0 f ≤
              C * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.hNorm s (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transportCover α f)) →
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PairHasDivisorBound α s
MathGauge.GP002.nativeL2Norm: (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2 → ℂ) → ℝ

MathGauge.GP002.nativeL2Norm_eq_h0: ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
  MathGauge.GP002.nativeL2Norm ⇑u = MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm 0 ⇑u

MathGauge.GP002.no_uniform_estimate_on_open: ∀ (J : Set ℝ),
  IsOpen J →
    J.Nonempty →
      ∀ (s C : ℝ),
        0 ≤ s →
          ¬∀ α ∈ J,
              Irrational α →
                ∀ (u : C(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2, ℂ)),
                  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u →
                    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑u →
                      MathGauge.GP002.nativeL2Norm ⇑u ≤
                        C * MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.nativeHNorm s (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport α ⇑u)
items.domains: 实际归一化积分L²范数、真实T²光滑零均值函数；只用给定的零阶估计，不偷偷要求所有r。
items.conclusions: 不存在题定参数邻域一致估计。
items.representation: 母题单频论证从单个r=0估计提取真实小除数下界；Mathlib的Liouville稠密性提供J内无理反例；显式证明积分L²等于题定Fourier H⁰，不仅改名。

items.assumptions: 精确α=Σ_{n≥1}10^(−n!)；不以任意Liouville数替换指定值。
quantifiers: MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection: ℝ
MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection_eq: MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection = liouvilleNumber 10 - 1 / 10
MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection_liouville: Liouville MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection
MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection_irrational: Irrational MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection
MathGauge.GP002.liouville_no_polynomial_bound: ∀ {α : ℝ}, Liouville α → ¬MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PolynomialDivisorBound α

MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection_unsolvable: ∃ F,
  MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth F ∧
    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑F ∧
      ¬∃ u,
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Smooth u ∧
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.MeanZero ⇑u ∧
              ∀ (y : MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Torus2),
                MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transport MathGauge.GP002.factorialDirection (⇑u) y = F y

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.bad_frequency_sequence: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ¬MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PolynomialDivisorBound α →
      ∃ q,
        Function.Injective q ∧
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            q n ≠ 0 ∧
              MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.weight (q n) ^ n *
                  ‖↑(n + 1) *
                      (MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.omega *
                        ↑(MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.pairDivisor α (q n)))‖ ≤
                (1 / 2) ^ n

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.exists_rapid_bad_inverse: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ¬MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PolynomialDivisorBound α →
      ∃ a,
        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.TorusInverse.Rapid a ∧
          a 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ (C : ℝ), ∃ k, C < ‖MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.generalInverseCoefficients α a k‖

MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.exists_smooth_unsolvable: ∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ¬MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.PolynomialDivisorBound α →
      ∃ f,
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f ∧
          MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.UnitPeriodic f ∧
            MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.coefficient f 0 = 0 ∧
              ¬∃ u,
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) u ∧
                    MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.UnitPeriodic u ∧
                      MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.Borrowed.SmoothFourierData.coefficient u 0 = 0 ∧
                        MathGauge.PublicProof.Torus.transportCover α u = f
items.domains: 一个固定的实际T²上光滑零均值复函数F；所有候选光滑零均值解同时被排除。
items.conclusions: 指定α无理，存在同一个F使原生方向微分方程无光滑零均值解。
items.representation: Mathlib的liouvilleNumber从n=0开始，已证明精确减1/10与题目相同；证明其Liouville性，再直接由任意逼近阶构造没有多项式频率下界。注入坏频率和Rapid系数的已有明确构造经真实Fourier重构产生一个F，不是每个C分别换右端。
